articles.title: World Ranger Day 2026 — Theme 'Rangers: Guardians of a Changing Planet'
articles.title_hi: विश्व रेंजर दिवस 2026 — थीम 'Rangers: Guardians of a Changing Planet'
articles.summary: World Ranger Day is observed on 31 July to honour rangers killed or injured in the line of duty and to recognise their role in protecting natural and cultural heritage.
articles.summary_hi: विश्व रेंजर दिवस 31 जुलाई को मनाया जाता है, जो कर्तव्य में शहीद या घायल रेंजरों को सम्मानित करता है और प्राकृतिक व सांस्कृतिक विरासत की रक्षा में उनकी भूमिका को पहचानता है।
articles.content:
World Ranger Day is observed every year on 31 July. The date marks the anniversary of the founding of the International Ranger Federation (IRF) in 1992. The observance, promoted by IRF together with The Thin Green Line Foundation, commemorates rangers killed or injured while protecting parks, wildlife, and heritage sites.

The 2026 edition marks 20 years since the first World Ranger Day in 2007. The 2026 theme is 'Rangers: Guardians of a Changing Planet', highlighting rangers as frontline workers against climate extremes, biodiversity loss, wildlife crime, and human-wildlife conflict.

For IB ACIO: 31 July, IRF founded 1992, first WRD 2007, 2026 theme — 'Guardians of a Changing Planet'.
articles.content_hi:
World Ranger Day: 31 जुलाई। IRF स्थापना — 1992। पहला WRD — 2007। 2026 थीम — 'Rangers: Guardians of a Changing Planet'।

IB ACIO: 31 July, IRF 1992 — याद रखें।
articles.question: World Ranger Day, observed on 31 July, marks the anniversary of the founding of which organisation in 1992?
articles.question_hi: 31 जुलाई को मनाया जाने वाला विश्व रेंजर दिवस 1992 में किस संगठन की स्थापना की वर्षगांठ है?
articles.explanation: World Ranger Day is linked to the International Ranger Federation (IRF), founded on 31 July 1992.
articles.explanation_hi: विश्व रेंजर दिवस International Ranger Federation (IRF) से जुड़ा है, जिसकी स्थापना 31 जुलाई 1992 को हुई।

articles.title: CWG 2026: Neeraj Chopra Wins Javelin Gold; Athletics Peak Day
articles.title_hi: CWG 2026: नीरज चोपड़ा ने भाला फेंक में स्वर्ण जीता; एथलेटिक्स का शिखर दिन
articles.summary: On Day 8 of Glasgow 2026, Neeraj Chopra defended his Commonwealth javelin title with a throw of 88.42m, as athletics delivered the largest share of the day's 44 gold medal events.
articles.summary_hi: ग्लासगो 2026 के 8वें दिन, नीरज चोपड़ा ने 88.42 मीटर के प्रदर्शन से अपना राष्ट्रमंडल भाला फेंक खिताब बचाया, जबकि एथलेटिक्स ने उस दिन के 44 स्वर्ण पदक कार्यक्रमों में सबसे बड़ा हिस्सा दिया।
articles.content:
On Day 8 (31 July) of the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra won gold in the men's javelin throw with 88.42m, reclaiming the title he first won at Gold Coast 2018. India also picked up medals in athletics and boxing on one of the busiest medal days of the Games.

Day 8 featured 44 gold medal events — the highest single-day tally — with athletics dominating the programme at Scotstoun Stadium. India's medal push continued across track, field, and combat sports.

For IB ACIO: Neeraj Chopra — CWG javelin gold, Day 8 (31 July), Glasgow 2026.
articles.content_hi:
CWG 2026, Day 8 (31 जुलाई): Neeraj Chopra — भाला फेंक स्वर्ण (88.42m)। दिन में 44 स्वर्ण पदक कार्यक्रम।

IB ACIO: Neeraj Chopra, 31 July — याद रखें।
articles.question: At Glasgow 2026, Neeraj Chopra won gold in the men's javelin throw on which day of the Games?
articles.question_hi: ग्लासगो 2026 में नीरज चोपड़ा ने पुरुष भाला फेंक में स्वर्ण किस दिन जीता?
articles.explanation: Neeraj Chopra won javelin gold on Day 8, 31 July 2026, at the Glasgow Commonwealth Games.
articles.explanation_hi: नीरज चोपड़ा ने ग्लासगो राष्ट्रमंडल खेलों में 31 जुलाई 2026 (दिन 8) को भाला फेंक स्वर्ण जीता।

articles.title: Cabinet Approves PM-AASHA Extension to Stabilise Farmgate Prices
articles.title_hi: कैबिनेट ने किसानों के गेट मूल्य स्थिर करने हेतु PM-AASHA विस्तार को मंजूरी दी
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet approved extension of the PM-AASHA umbrella scheme for three years (2026-27 to 2028-29) to support MSP-based procurement and price-deficiency payment for oilseeds, pulses, and copra.
articles.summary_hi: केंद्रीय कैबिनेट ने तेलबीज, दालें और खोपरा के लिए MSP-आधारित खरीद और मूल्य-कमी भुगतान के समर्थन हेतु PM-AASHA छत्रीय योजना के तीन वर्ष (2026-27 से 2028-29) के विस्तार को मंजूरी दी।
articles.content:
In July 2026, the Union Cabinet approved the extension of Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA) for three years from 2026-27 to 2028-29. The umbrella scheme consolidates Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS), and pilot components for market intervention.

PM-AASHA, launched in 2018, aims to ensure remunerative prices to farmers beyond MSP operations for paddy and wheat. The extension focuses on oilseeds, pulses, and copra amid volatility in global commodity markets.

For IB ACIO: PM-AASHA launched 2018, extended 2026-29, components — PSS, PDPS, MIS-PSS.
articles.content_hi:
PM-AASHA: लॉन्च — 2018। विस्तार — 2026-27 से 2028-29। घटक — PSS, PDPS, MIS-PSS। फोकस — तेलबीज, दालें, खोपरा।

IB ACIO: PM-AASHA 2018 — याद रखें।
articles.question: PM-AASHA (Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan), extended by the Cabinet in July 2026, was originally launched in:
articles.question_hi: जुलाई 2026 में कैबिनेट द्वारा विस्तारित PM-AASHA की मूल शुरुआत कब हुई थी?
articles.explanation: PM-AASHA was launched in 2018 as an umbrella scheme to supplement MSP operations for farmers.
articles.explanation_hi: PM-AASHA 2018 में किसानों के लिए MSP संचालन को पूरक करने हेतु छत्रीय योजना के रूप में शुरू की गई।

articles.title: Lt Gen NS Raja Subramani Appointed Vice Chief of Army Staff
articles.title_hi: लेफ्टिनेंट जनरल एन.एस. राजा सुब्रमणि को सेना उप प्रमुख नियुक्त
articles.summary: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet appointed Lt Gen NS Raja Subramani as Vice Chief of Army Staff, succeeding Lt Gen RK Singh.
articles.summary_hi: मंत्रिमंडल की नियुक्ति समिति ने लेफ्टिनेंट जनरल एन.एस. राजा सुब्रमणि को सेना उप प्रमुख नियुक्त किया, जो लेफ्टिनेंट जनरल आर.के. सिंह का स्थान लेंगे।
articles.content:
In July 2026, the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) appointed Lt Gen NS Raja Subramani, PVSM, AVSM, SM, as Vice Chief of Army Staff (VCOAS). He succeeds Lt Gen RK Singh, who superannuates.

Lt Gen Subramani, an infantry officer commissioned in 1987, has served in key operational and staff appointments including Director General of Military Operations. The VCOAS assists the Chief of Army Staff in operational planning and force modernisation.

For IB ACIO: VCOAS — Lt Gen NS Raja Subramani, ACC appointment, July 2026.
articles.content_hi:
VCOAS — Lt Gen NS Raja Subramani (ACC, जुलाई 2026)। पूर्ववर्ती — Lt Gen RK Singh।

IB ACIO: VCOAS Subramani — याद रखें।
articles.question: In July 2026, who was appointed as Vice Chief of Army Staff by the ACC?
articles.question_hi: जुलाई 2026 में ACC द्वारा सेना उप प्रमुख के रूप में किसे नियुक्त किया गया?
articles.explanation: Lt Gen NS Raja Subramani was appointed Vice Chief of Army Staff in July 2026, succeeding Lt Gen RK Singh.

articles.title: ISRO Successfully Tests Reusable Launch Vehicle Landing Experiment (RLV-LEX-03)
articles.title_hi: ISRO ने पुन: प्रयोज्य प्रक्षेपण वाहन लैंडिंग प्रयोग (RLV-LEX-03) सफलतापूर्वक परीक्षण किया
articles.summary: ISRO completed RLV-LEX-03 at Challakere, Karnataka, advancing India's reusable launch vehicle programme toward autonomous runway landing after hypersonic re-entry simulation.
articles.summary_hi: ISRO ने कर्नाटक के चल्लाकेरे में RLV-LEX-03 पूरा किया, जो हाइपरसोनिक पुन: प्रवेश अनुकरण के बाद स्वायत्त रनवे लैंडिंग की दिशा में भारत के पुन: प्रयोज्य प्रक्षेपण वाहन कार्यक्रम को आगे बढ़ाता है।
articles.content:
In July 2026, the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully conducted the Reusable Launch Vehicle Landing Experiment (RLV-LEX-03) at the Aeronautical Test Range, Challakere, Karnataka. A winged body was air-dropped from a helicopter and executed an autonomous landing on a runway.

The experiment supports ISRO's Reusable Launch Vehicle-Technology Demonstrator (RLV-TD) programme aimed at reducing space access costs. Earlier LEX missions validated navigation, guidance, and control systems for approach and landing.

For IB ACIO: RLV-LEX-03, ISRO, Challakere, reusable launch vehicle programme.
articles.content_hi:
RLV-LEX-03: ISRO, Challakere (कर्नाटक)। उद्देश्य — पुन: प्रयोज्य प्रक्षेपण वाहन, कम लागत अंतरिक्ष पहुंच।

IB ACIO: RLV-LEX, ISRO — याद रखें।
articles.question: ISRO's RLV-LEX-03 landing experiment in July 2026 was conducted at:
articles.question_hi: जुलाई 2026 में ISRO का RLV-LEX-03 लैंडिंग प्रयोग कहाँ आयोजित किया गया?
articles.explanation: RLV-LEX-03 was conducted at the Aeronautical Test Range, Challakere, Karnataka.
articles.explanation_hi: RLV-LEX-03 कर्नाटक के चल्लाकेरे स्थित एयरोनॉटिकल टेस्ट रेंज में आयोजित किया गया।

articles.title: India, UAE Sign Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) Review Protocol
articles.title_hi: भारत और UAE ने व्यापक आर्थिक साझेदारी समझौता (CEPA) समीक्षा प्रोटोकॉल पर हस्ताक्षर किए
articles.summary: India and the UAE signed a protocol to review their 2022 CEPA, expanding market access for gems, jewellery, textiles, and pharmaceuticals and strengthening rules of origin cooperation.
articles.summary_hi: भारत और UAE ने अपने 2022 CEPA की समीक्षा हेतु प्रोटोकॉल पर हस्ताक्षर किए, जिससे रत्न, आभूषण, textiles और फार्मास्युटिकल्स के लिए बाजार पहुंच बढ़ेगी और मूल नियम सहयोग मजबूत होगा।
articles.content:
In July 2026, India and the United Arab Emirates signed a review protocol under their Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), which entered into force in May 2022. The protocol expands tariff concessions and trade facilitation in goods and services.

India-UAE CEPA was India's first bilateral trade pact with a Gulf country in over a decade. The review adds chapters on digital trade cooperation and MSME market access. UAE remains among India's top three trading partners.

For IB ACIO: India-UAE CEPA — effective 2022, first major Gulf FTA in decade, reviewed 2026.
articles.content_hi:
India-UAE CEPA: प्रभावी — 2022 (मई)। भारत का पहला प्रमुख खाड़ी FTA (दशक में)। 2026 समीक्षा प्रोटोकॉल।

IB ACIO: India-UAE CEPA 2022 — याद रखें।
articles.question: India's Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) with the UAE, reviewed in July 2026, originally entered into force in:
articles.question_hi: जुलाई 2026 में समीक्षित भारत-UAE CEPA मूल रूप से कब प्रभावी हुआ था?
articles.explanation: The India-UAE CEPA entered into force in May 2022.
articles.explanation_hi: भारत-UAE CEPA मई 2022 में प्रभावी हुआ था।

articles.title: MHA Launches 'Cyber Suraksha Mitra' Volunteer Programme Nationwide
articles.title_hi: MHA ने राष्ट्रव्यापी 'Cyber Suraksha Mitra' स्वयंसेवी कार्यक्रम शुरू किया
articles.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs launched 'Cyber Suraksha Mitra' to train community volunteers in cyber hygiene and fraud reporting through the 1930 helpline and NCRP portal.
articles.summary_hi: गृह मंत्रालय ने 'Cyber Suraksha Mitra' शुरू किया, जो 1930 हेल्पलाइन और NCRP पोर्टल के माध्यम से साइबर स्वच्छता और धोखाधड़ी रिपोर्टिंग में सामुदायिक स्वयंसेवकों को प्रशिक्षित करेगा।
articles.content:
In July 2026, the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) launched the 'Cyber Suraksha Mitra' programme to create a network of trained volunteers who educate citizens on cyber hygiene, OTP fraud, and digital arrest scams. Volunteers are linked to the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C).

The initiative complements the e-Zero FIR system and National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (NCRP). States with high cyber fraud incidence, including Delhi and Chandigarh, will pilot district-level Mitra hubs first.

For IB ACIO: Cyber Suraksha Mitra, MHA, I4C, links to NCRP and 1930 helpline.
articles.content_hi:
Cyber Suraksha Mitra: MHA, I4C से जुड़ा। फोकस — OTP fraud, digital arrest scams। NCRP, 1930 के पूरक।

IB ACIO: Cyber Suraksha Mitra — याद रखें।
articles.question: The 'Cyber Suraksha Mitra' programme launched by MHA in July 2026 is linked to which coordinating centre?
articles.question_hi: जुलाई 2026 में MHA द्वारा शुरू 'Cyber Suraksha Mitra' कार्यक्रम किस समन्वय केंद्र से जुड़ा है?
articles.explanation: Cyber Suraksha Mitra volunteers are coordinated through the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C).
articles.explanation_hi: Cyber Suraksha Mitra स्वयंसेवक Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) के माध्यम से समन्वित किए जाते हैं।

articles.title: RBI Keeps Repo Rate Unchanged at 5.50% in August MPC Review
articles.title_hi: RBI ने अगस्त MPC समीक्षा में रेपो दर 5.50% अपरिवर्तित रखी
articles.summary: The RBI Monetary Policy Committee unanimously kept the policy repo rate at 5.50% with a neutral stance, citing moderating inflation and stable growth momentum.
articles.summary_hi: RBI की monetary policy committee ने तटस्थ रुख के साथ नीति रेपो दर 5.50% अपरिवर्तित रखी, जिसमें मध्यम होती महंगाई और स्थिर वृद्धि गति का हवाला दिया गया।
articles.content:
In its August 2026 review, the Reserve Bank of India's six-member Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) voted unanimously to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 5.50%. The stance was retained as 'neutral'.

Governor-led RBI noted that CPI inflation is aligning toward the 4% target while domestic growth remains resilient. The decision follows cumulative rate cuts earlier in the cycle. CRR was also left unchanged.

For IB ACIO: MPC, repo rate 5.50%, neutral stance, August 2026 review.
articles.content_hi:
RBI MPC (अगस्त 2026): रेपो दर — 5.50% (अपरिवर्तित), रुख — neutral, unanimous vote।

IB ACIO: MPC repo 5.50% — याद रखें।
articles.question: In the RBI's August 2026 MPC meeting, the policy repo rate was kept unchanged at:

articles.explanation: The MPC kept the policy repo rate unchanged at 5.50% with a neutral stance.
articles.explanation_hi: MPC ने तटस्थ रुख के साथ नीति रेपो दर 5.50% अपरिवर्तित रखी।

articles.title: Government Notifies Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2026
articles.title_hi: सरकार ने Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2026 अधिसूचित किए
articles.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and IT notified rules under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, detailing consent mechanisms, data fiduciary obligations, and penalties for significant breaches.
articles.summary_hi: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स और IT मंत्रालय ने Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 के तहत नियम अधिसूचित किए, जिनमें सहमति तंत्र, डेटा प्रत्ययी दायित्व और गंभीर उल्लंघन हेतु दंड का विवरण है।
articles.content:
In July 2026, the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) notified the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2026 under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. The rules operationalise consent managers, breach reporting timelines, and children's data safeguards.

The Data Protection Board of India will adjudicate significant breaches. Significant data fiduciaries must appoint Data Protection Officers. The Act applies to digital personal data processed within India and certain offshore processing linked to Indian goods and services.

For IB ACIO: DPDP Act 2023, Rules 2026, MeitY, Data Protection Board of India.
articles.content_hi:
DPDP Act, 2023 → Rules, 2026 (MeitY)। Data Protection Board of India, consent managers, breach reporting।

IB ACIO: DPDP Act 2023 — याद रखें।
articles.question: The Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2026 were notified under which Act?
articles.question_hi: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2026 किस अधिनियम के तहत अधिसूचित किए गए?
articles.explanation: The 2026 Rules were framed under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
articles.explanation_hi: 2026 के नियम Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 के तहत बनाए गए।

articles.title: UN Declares 2026 as International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists
articles.title_hi: UN ने 2026 को अंतर्राष्ट्रीय रेंजलैंड और पशुचर वर्ष घोषित किया
articles.summary: The United Nations observed 2026 as the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists (IYRP) to highlight the role of pastoral communities in food security, biodiversity, and climate resilience.
articles.summary_hi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र ने 2026 को अंतर्राष्ट्रीय रेंजलैंड और पशुचर वर्ष (IYRP) के रूप में मनाया, जो खाद्य सुरक्षा, जैव विविधता और जलवायु लचीलापन में पशुचर समुदायों की भूमिका उजागर करता है।
articles.content:
The United Nations declared 2026 as the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists (IYRP), following a UN General Assembly resolution. The year highlights the ecological and cultural contributions of pastoral and mobile livestock-rearing communities across rangelands covering over half the world's land surface.

India's pastoral communities — including Gujjars, Bakarwals, Raikas, and Maldharis — feature in national IYRP events coordinated by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change and civil society partners.
